task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, take a trip south. Okay, and then, ensure that the gateway inside the shower is open. After opening the gateway, go to the west. Then, go west. With that over with, try to go to the south. Following that, attempt to take a trip west. And then, lift the poem from the floor of the parlor. That's it!
description:
You're now in a sauna.



There is an open gate leading south. There is an unblocked exit to the west.

thought: I should go south through the open gate.
